blurb.text: An Austrian Landwein (PGI) area whose most planted grapes are Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc, each at 15 percent of vineyard area, followed by Pinot Noir, Muscat Blanc and Grüner Veltliner.

sources.name: Anderson, Nelgen and Puga, Database of Regional, National and Global Winegrape Bearing Areas by Variety, 2000 to 2023, University of Adelaide (CC BY 4.0)
